checks.result: npm ci, check, build, test and fixture learning passed without Python/compiler calls
3 network tests and 4 fixture Agent evaluation cases
8 functional browser tests with local Chromium

proof: Main and background Works have independent execution sessions. A repeated background request returns the same Work and session after restart; the same requestId with changed content is rejected.

Bounded main, background, evaluation, model and queue capacities are parsed from ROCKY_* settings and frozen per daemon. Each Work persists its active wall time budget and selected model connection revision.

Two Works naming the same opaque resource key do not run together. The queued waiter starts no worker and takes no model slot; a different resource can run. An interrupted owner blocks same-resource re-admission after restart.

The Store CAS prevents mutation of submitted text, transport, mode, kind, resource key, wall budget, run mode, model selection and model budget. A queued Work never adopts another Work's updated connection.

A held model request fails when active wall time is exhausted without claiming success; time spent waiting for a human approval does not consume that budget. Unknown effects still require reconciliation.
limitations: The resource key is an opaque submission UUID, not a canonical workspace path or OS lock. T-017 must establish real workspace identity and containment.
Admission and model slots are per daemon process, not provider-enforced or distributed quotas. A provider request already sent cannot prove that billing stopped on abort.
The restart test uses an isolated seeded crash boundary; a power-loss test was not performed.
Ubuntu, strict browser egress, and a live paid model were not run. Global acceptance tests remain not_run.
No remote repository, push, merge, tag or deployment action was performed.
